description: Phase 1: Auth Foundation - Supabase SDK integration, auth state management, bookie signup/login flows, Sign in with Apple, password reset, and auth gate navigation. IMPORTANT: Maintain the existing dark sports-betting theme styling (Theme.swift).

userStories.title: Add Supabase SDK and Configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Supabase Swift SDK integrated so I can use auth and database services.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Supabase Swift SDK via Swift Package Manager (https://github.com/supabase/supabase-swift)
Create Booki/Config/ directory if it doesn't exist
Create SupabaseConfig.swift that reads SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from environment or Info.plist
Create SupabaseClient.swift in Booki/Services/ as a singleton with shared instance
Client provides access to auth and database via `SupabaseClient.shared.client`
Add placeholder values in Info.plist for SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Foundation for all Supabase integration. User will replace placeholder values with real credentials.

userStories.title: Create Auth State Manager
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a centralized auth state manager to track login status and current user.
acceptanceCriteria: Create AuthManager.swift in Booki/Services/ as an ObservableObject class
Add published properties: isAuthenticated (Bool), isLoading (Bool), currentUserId (String?)
Add UserRole enum (bookie, player) and published userRole property
Initialize by checking Supabase session on init
Listen to Supabase auth state changes via onAuthStateChange
Implement signOut() method that calls Supabase auth.signOut()
Add @StateObject authManager and .environmentObject(authManager) in BookiApp.swift
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Central source of truth for auth state throughout the app

userStories.title: Create Bookie Signup Flow
userStories.description: As a new bookie, I want to create an account with email and password so I can start using the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SignUpView.swift in Booki/Views/Auth/
Add text fields: email, password, confirmPassword with SecureField for passwords
Add validation: email format (contains @), password min 8 chars, passwords match
Show inline validation errors below fields
Add 'Create Account' button that calls Supabase auth.signUp(email:password:)
Show loading state during signup
On success: show alert 'Check your email to verify your account'
Handle errors: display user-friendly messages for email taken, weak password, network error
Add 'Already have an account? Log in' link at bottom
Use Theme styling (Theme.background, Theme.cardBackground, Theme.accent, etc.)
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Email verification is handled by Supabase automatically

userStories.title: Create Bookie Login Flow
userStories.description: As a returning bookie, I want to log in with my credentials so I can access my book.
acceptanceCriteria: Create LoginView.swift in Booki/Views/Auth/
Add text fields: email, password (SecureField)
Add 'Log In' button that calls Supabase auth.signIn(email:password:)
Show loading state during login
On success: AuthManager updates automatically via auth state listener
Handle errors: display messages for invalid credentials, unverified email, network error
Add 'Forgot Password?' link (navigates to ForgotPasswordView)
Add 'Don't have an account? Sign up' link at bottom
Use Theme styling consistent with app
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Auth state change triggers navigation automatically

userStories.title: Add Sign in with Apple
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to sign in with Apple for faster, more secure authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Sign in with Apple' capability comment in code (actual capability added manually in Xcode)
Create AppleSignInButton.swift in Booki/Views/Auth/ using SignInWithAppleButton
Implement Apple Sign-In coordinator/handler
On Apple auth success: call Supabase auth.signInWithIdToken(provider: .apple, idToken:)
Handle new user vs returning user (Supabase handles this)
Add AppleSignInButton to both LoginView and SignUpView
Handle errors: user cancelled, failed, network error
Use dark style button to match app theme
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Requires Apple Developer account and Supabase Apple provider setup. Button will show but won't fully work without configuration.

userStories.title: Implement Password Reset Flow
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to reset my password if I forget it so I can regain access.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ForgotPasswordView.swift in Booki/Views/Auth/
Add email text field and 'Send Reset Link' button
Call Supabase auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email)
On success: show confirmation message 'Check your email for a reset link'
Handle errors: email not found, network error
Add 'Back to Login' link
Use Theme styling consistent with app
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Deep link handling for password reset can be added later. User resets via web for now.

userStories.title: Create Auth Gate and Navigation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the app to show login/signup when unauthenticated and main app when authenticated.
acceptanceCriteria: Create AuthGateView.swift in Booki/Views/
Inject AuthManager via @EnvironmentObject
If authManager.isLoading: show loading spinner with app logo
If !authManager.isAuthenticated: show LoginView
If authManager.isAuthenticated: show existing ContentView/MainTabView
Update BookiApp.swift to use AuthGateView as the root view
Navigation updates automatically when auth state changes (login/logout)
Logout from anywhere returns to LoginView
Use Theme styling for loading state
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: This gates the entire app behind authentication
